title: Wilson meeting at the EG&G parking lot where Bob Lazar worked

tellings.quote: that meeting took place in the parking lot & which is where Bob Lazar I pretty sure worked

plain: A 2002 meeting between Admiral Thomas Wilson and Eric W. Davis, written up in Davis's notes, which are known as the Wilson-Davis memo, took place in a parking lot at EG&G, a defence contractor. Michels points out that EG&G is, he is "pretty sure", where Bob Lazar worked. Lazar is a man famous in UFO circles for saying he worked on alien craft. Michels makes the link himself while talking with the UFO investigator James Fox. It would tie the memo's meeting to the same company behind one of the best-known UFO accounts.
